boundary: Full original World map/startup. Original ground firing, pickTarget, direct physical flight contact, flight progression, hurt, ability command, aimed launch, timer and ordinary infantry death components. Explicit scene priming, authored terrain unchanged; no full tick/navigation/building retirement claim.
claimsEncoding: claims preserves the actual source Map entries. logicalClaims is a sorted projection keyed by target and team, retaining rawKey (source target*8+team). No source iteration-order claim.
snapshotEncoding: startup.initial contains every startup actor. Each snapshot actors array overlays changed or new rows by id; actorOrder gives every surviving id in insertion order. Absent ids are removed. Unlisted actor rows retain their startup values.
